caption: The drawing depicts two views of a figurine modeled as a rotund man standing on a rectangular pedestal. The man is dressed in a black top hat, long brownish-red coat, blue vest, blue bow tie, and blue trousers, with white shirt cuffs and white shoes. His face is pinkish with red cheeks, red lips, and visible lines suggesting age, and he has shoulder-length brown hair. In the frontal view on the left, he holds a large, round clock against his stomach with Roman numerals on the clock face and two black clock hands pointing to about 10:00. The side view on the right shows the same figure turned to the left, revealing more of the coat’s back, a thick book or object under his arm, and the brim of his hat at an angle. The base for each is brown with a stepped design. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The drawing primarily uses earth tones, blue, black, and some red accents on the figure’s face and bow tie.
title: Clock-Toby (front and side view)
